title: account_inventory_snapshot v1
description: Summary of one read of the local account database. Emitted once per pass, after every account_record of the same run_id, so it also marks the pass as complete. Emitted even when the source could not be read.

source_status.description: read: parsed. unreadable: open or read failed. implausible: readable but has no UID 0 entry, so its content cannot be trusted.

source_error.description: Why the source was not read. Only when source_status is not read.

uid_min.description: Lowest UID the agent emits an account_record for.

entries_total.description: Lines of the source with a numeric UID, at any UID.

records_emitted.description: account_record facts emitted in this run_id. The engine compares it with the records it received.

duplicate_uids.description: UIDs held by more than one entry, at any UID. Empty array when there are none.
